subject: Broker proxy degradation impacting private deployment - coordination and follow-up
messages:
From: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@zenhealth.ai>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: support@zenhealth.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: High error rate for inference calls through our private deployment

Hi Logan —

We're seeing a spike in 5xx errors and TCP resets for most inference requests routed to our ZenHealth private deployment (deployment id: zen-priv-17). Impact started ~07:45 PDT and we've been throttled to ~30% of normal successful requests. Attached is a screenshot of the dashboard and a couple of request IDs.

Symptom summary:
- ~07:45 PDT: sharp increase in 502/504 and connection resets
- Affected region: us-west-2 (our VPC peer with Redwood)
- Some retries eventually succeed but latency spikes to 4-6s

Can you triage and advise next steps? We have a batch processing window at 10:00 that will be blocked if not resolved. Please escalate if needed.

Thanks,
Claire Thompson
Head of Platform, ZenHealth
claire.thompson@zenhealth.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@zenhealth.ai>, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate for inference calls through our private deployment

Claire / Logan —

Quick triage update after initial traces: we see a concentrated pattern of TCP resets originating from the broker-proxy sidecar that sits in the private controlplane path. Details below:

What we observed:
- Increased accept queue latency on broker-proxy (proc: broker-proxy v2.4.1 -> v2.5.0 rolling upgrade)
- Spike in CPU load at ~07:33-07:50 on the updated nodes correlating with proxy restarts
- Connection CLOSE_WAIT and many half-open connections leading to upstream resets
- Error pattern affects only private deployments in us-west-2, consistent with a canary roll in that AZ

Immediate actions taken:
- Paused the broker-proxy rollout across us-west-2 at 08:40 PDT
- Redirected new controlplane connections to the standby replicas in us-east-1 for affected tenancy groups (temporary routing)
- Collected full tcpdumps/traces (packaged as connectivity-traces.zip) and broker metrics (broker-metrics-09-18.csv)

Next steps:
- We are rolling back nodes patched to v2.5.0 to the prior stable image (v2.4.1) in the affected ASG. ETA for rollback completion: 40-50 minutes from now.
- Post-rollback, we'll validate with a targeted canary (small flows) and then slowly open routing back to us-west-2.

Claire — could you confirm whether you can accept temporary routing to us-east-1 (there's minor cross-region latency increase, ~30-50ms) for the next 90 minutes while we finish rollback? If you prefer no cross-region routing we'll keep routing local but that may extend the mitigation window.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments:
- connectivity-traces.zip
- broker-metrics-09-18.csv

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@zenhealth.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate for inference calls through our private deployment

Team / Claire —

Rollback completed at ~11:55 PDT for the affected nodes; verified broker-proxy image back to v2.4.1. Observed metrics: connection resets dropped to baseline within three minutes of rollback. We also applied a throttling config on the canary channel to avoid surge during warmup.

Customer-facing summary (for ZenHealth):
- Root cause (prelim): a regression in broker-proxy v2.5.0 that increased CPU pressure during connection drain, triggering connection resets for private controlplane connections in the canary AZ.
- Mitigation: paused rollout & rolled back affected nodes; temporarily routed new connections through standby replicas in us-east-1 to reduce customer impact while rollback completed.
- Current status: healthy — request success rates restored to expected levels; batch window should be clear.

Follow-ups we own:
1) Postmortem doc + timeline for Claire by EOD tomorrow 9/19 (draft attached).
2) Hardening: add pre-rollout performance stress test for proxy image changes.
3) Add automated early-warning rule on accept-queue latency and half-open connections.
4) Verify canary isolation so private deployments are excluded from risky broad rollouts.

I'm attaching the rollback commands we executed (runbook-rollback-commands.txt) and the traces for your ops team if you want to cross-check.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Software Engineer, Orchestration
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments:
- runbook-rollback-commands.txt

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@zenhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Postmortem draft: broker-proxy upgrade caused connection resets (zen-priv-17)

Hi all —

Attached is postmortem-v0.2.md (drive link below) for internal review and for Claire's review before we publish the customer-facing postmortem. Please focus review on: (a) timeline accuracy, (b) action items assigned, and (c) wording for the external summary.

Executive summary (draft):
- Incident window: 2028-09-18 07:33 - 2028-09-18 11:55 PDT
- Impact: elevated 5xx/error rate and connection resets for ZenHealth private deployment (zen-priv-17) in us-west-2 during a broker-proxy rolling upgrade canary.
- Root cause: regression in broker-proxy v2.5.0 that led to accept-queue growth and CPU pressure on canary nodes, causing connection destabilization for the private controlplane path.
- Mitigation: paused rollout, rolled back to v2.4.1, temporary routing to standby replicas in us-east-1.

Proposed actions (high-level):
- Add targeted pre-rollout perf gating for controlplane proxies. Owner: aditya.rao.
- Add automated alerting on accept-queue latency and half-open connection counts. Owner: soojin.lee.
- Create canary isolation policy for private deployments so they don't receive broad rollouts. Owner: logan.wright + product.

Drive link (internal): https://drive.redwood.com/ZenHealth/incident-20280918/postmortem-v0.2.md
HBSP ticket: HBSP-4521

Please get comments by EOD today — we aim to publish customer-facing summary and postmortem link tomorrow morning (9/20).

Thanks,
— Logan

Attachments:
- postmortem-v0.2.md
